market_scope: x402-list indexed services and monitored facilitators; not full ecosystem

comparison_to_2026_10_13_snapshot.warning: Rolling 30-day windows and dynamic indexed cohorts differ; changes are not net customer acquisition, revenue growth or verified usage growth.

caveats: Publisher figures not independently audited or re-run from on-chain data.
Service counts are directory listings, not paying customers or actual buyers.
Delivery verification is x402 List verification, not proof of payments or AgentMine customer validation.
Buyer addresses are not unique businesses or humans; self-payments/automation possible.
Top service data are imported and largest buyer is 98.9% of its measured volume.
Measured flow coverage is relative to this publisher measured facilitators, not entire ecosystem.
Rolling windows and indexed cohort membership vary between snapshots; no causal inference.
decision_implication: Payment-ready listing supply greatly exceeds delivery-verified service count, but this alone does not prove demand for reliability SaaS; directory already offers monitoring. Validate willingness to pay for a measurable supplier outcome before building.
